Have you noticed a smell, loud fan or a filter warning?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Switch off and unplug the air purifier before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning an appliance that is plugged in risks an electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the air purifier yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: Change the main filter when the indicator or your manual says so.
care_tips.why: A full filter stops cleaning the air.

care_tips.text: Clean the pre-filter as the manual describes.
care_tips.why: A dusty pre-filter blocks the air.

care_tips.text: Keep space around the inlets and outlet.
Use filters made for your model.
care_tips.why: Ill-fitting filters let dust bypass them.

care_tips.text: If the fan gets loud or there is a smell after a filter change, contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: These can be signs of a fan problem.

reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.
